source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the unnamed enthroned figures, explicit beheading and the relation of the two described groups without imposing a millennial scheme.
key_decisions.before: Then I saw thrones, and seated on them were those to whom authority to judge was given. Also I saw the souls of people who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and people who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
key_decisions.after: I saw thrones, and those seated on them were given authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and God's word, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image or received its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then I saw thrones, and seated on them were those to whom authority to judge was given. Also I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interruption and named resurrection without resolving the chronology beyond the text.
key_decisions.before: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the first resurrection.
key_decisions.after: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were ended. This is the first resurrection.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves all three figures and the duration without narrowing the plural they.
key_decisions.before: and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the beast and the false prophet were, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
key_decisions.after: The devil who led them astray was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the beast and the false prophet were, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the destruction of personified Death/Hades and the text's explicit identification.
key_decisions.before: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
key_decisions.after: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death: the lake of fire.
